name: Leverage Sampler
description: Identifies influential datapoints by iteratively refitting models using leave-one-out validation. Computes how much each point affects model performance and selects candidates based on their influence.

leverage_sample.name: num_samples
leverage_sample.description: Number of influential samples to select from the condition pool.

leverage_sample.name: fit
leverage_sample.description: Selection strategy for influential points: 'both' selects points that either increase or decrease fit, 'increase' selects only points that increase fit when removed, 'decrease' selects only points that decrease fit when removed.

leverage_sample.name: sd
leverage_sample.description: Standard deviation of Gaussian noise added around selected points.

leverage_sample.name: random_state
leverage_sample.description: Random seed for reproducibility of noise generation.

variables.name: conditions
variables.description: Pool of candidate experimental conditions (independent variables).

variables.name: Y
variables.description: Pool of dependent variables corresponding to the conditions.

variables.name: models
variables.description: Scikit-learn compatible regression or classification model(s) to evaluate leverage.

outputDataType.name: conditions
outputDataType.description: Selected influential experimental conditions with added Gaussian noise.
